# Native C integer optimization flags

Generated by optional `scripts/check_integer_flags_c_parity.py --write` and
`scripts/check_projection_flags_c_parity.py --write`. Each data file records
source SHA-256 hashes and compiler options; verbatim excerpts and extraction
boundaries live in `c_toolbox/`. Cargo tests use only these saved records and
never read, compile or invoke the toolbox or C reference.

* `c_integer_flags.txt`: 70 seven-line records: name/seed/declared width/raw
  headers/global complex/normalized orbital complex/count/status, AP input,
  optional P input (blank when absent), component flags, coefficient hex bits,
  next 624 native SFMT words, and C-selected SR component indices. Init uses
  real flags >0; SR uses component flags ==1. Raw flags -2/0/1/2/3, ignored
  labels, real/complex AP/P combinations and header 2 are covered.
* `c_dh_flags.txt`: 24 five-line records: name/family/complex, encoded body,
  C status/flag count, full flags with two preceding parameters, neighbors.
  Complete valid geometry; raw -2/-1/0/1/2/3 flags are kept in row order.
* `c_shift_flags.txt`: 86 three-line records: name and G/J/DH2/DH4 counts,
  input component flags, C SetFlagShift GJ/DH2/DH4 gates. Every real slot is
  tested with -2/0/2/3; missing families and nonbinary imaginary flags are
  included. Rust checks factor eligibility, not native C shift arithmetic.

Real-mode unwritten imaginary cells are explicitly zeroed by the probes.
Their zeros are deterministic test storage, not evidence of malloc contents.
C normalizes positive orbital header sums to 1 before the orbital readers;
argument-2 standalone reader checks do not describe production flag values.
The C SR excerpt supplies selection only; Rust direct and CG paths verify
those selections on controlled covariance data, without claiming full C
solver, MPI or sampling equivalence.

Historical Julia fixture bytes remain unchanged. DH diagnostic tests retain
all prior diagnostics except the old binary-only flag rejection; new native
records prove that extension. Historical layout checks account explicitly
for unused real imaginary zeros and independent complex-P imaginary flags.
Strict G/J/RBM family reading, RBM storage and OptTrans policy remain open
under #21/#26/#27; these fixtures are not full-family completion evidence.
